load_mtl_materials: load material properties and texture images from an .mtl file given material names and data directory
make_mesh_texture_atlas: build a per-face texture atlas tensor from material properties, texture images, and UV coordinates for a mesh
make_material_atlas: create a per-face texture map from a single texture image and face vertex UV coordinates using barycentric interpolation
parse_mtl_file: parse an .mtl file to extract material properties like diffuse, ambient, specular colors and texture file references
bilinear_interpolation_grid_sample: bilinearly interpolate texture values from an image using UV grid coordinates via torch grid_sample
